instruction: Set up a local Thunderbird filter to forward all incoming messages from the anonym-x2024@outlook.com account to admin-backup@fastmail.com. Configure this in Thunderbird only, don't touch the online account settings.

metadata.explanation: Variation with different forward target email (admin-backup@fastmail.com). Evaluator verifies filter is enabled, action is Forward, target is admin-backup@fastmail.com, and condition is ALL. Same complexity as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic coverage gap: Instruction requires filtering messages FROM 'anonym-x2024@outlook.com' but evaluator only checks condition=['ALL'] without verifying the sender filter
The evaluator will incorrectly pass if the filter forwards ALL messages (from any sender) to admin-backup@fastmail.com, not just messages from anonym-x2024@outlook.com
Missing verification of FROM condition in the filter rules - expected should include something like 'AND (from,is,anonym-x2024@outlook.com)' in the condition array
The expected rules structure is incomplete - it specifies 'condition: ["ALL"]' which means 'match all conditions' but doesn't specify WHAT conditions to match (i.e., the sender email address)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update expected.rules.expect[0].condition to include the sender filter, e.g., ['AND (from,is,anonym-x2024@outlook.com)'] or similar pattern that matches the actual filter condition syntax
Verify the actual Thunderbird filter file format to determine the exact condition syntax for 'from' filters

Alternatively, if 'ALL' is intended to mean 'all messages in this account', add explicit verification that the filter is configured for the outlook.office365.com/anonym-x2024@outlook.com account context
